commit_message:
chore(drivers): update NativeAdreno for metal clients beside the render server

Picks up the user client change that serves Metal clients next to the
render server.

"""Run the board's archive builders ([kernel] archives of board.toml), in order, then check the prebuilt archives.
Each entry is a script of the build tree with its arguments. The kernel link needs their archives, and some of
them read the compile records that an XNU pass leaves behind. A configuration opts in with
CONFIG_XNU_BUILD_ARCHIVES; the bootstrap pass and first-console configurations have no archives to build.
# Archives that no builder produces (they need inputs outside the repositories) must be supplied.
if key.endswith('_ARCHIVE') and value.endswith('.a') and not Path(value).is_file():
# The archive builders and the boot progress layer read compile records of the XNU build, which only an earlier

# skip the archive checks and link without the archives, so it stops at the link and only the records are
log('kernel: bootstrap pass for the compile records')
# emit_prelink refuses to overwrite; a rebuild replaces the previous candidate and its record.
OPTIONAL_STEPS = ('userdata',)   # large; built only when named
p.add_argument('--kernel', metavar='FILE', help='prelinked kernel Mach-O for the payload (default: the kernel step output)')
wanted = {name for step in steps for name in REFERENCES.get(step, ())}
steps = [step for step in steps if step != 'userdata']
modules = prepare(ctx, steps + (['kernel'] if 'prelink' in steps else []))
# The first pass of a new tree (XNU_BOOTSTRAP=1, set by the unixnu driver) only has to leave the compile records and
for archive, record in zip(sys.argv[1:], records):
first, second = [record['bindings'] for record in records]
# External sources of UniXNU. "commit" pins a source; "path" (optional) fetches only that
# feeds.toml, and a local = "DIR" entry (or the unixnu command line) points a source at a local tree.
# These are Apple open source references and edk2; none of them is copied into a UniXNU repository.
driverkit_tag = "xnu-10063.121.3"    # earlier tag that still has iokit/DriverKit headers

@@ -0,0 +1,207 @@
+name: macOS build
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      device_repository:
+        description: Device repository as owner/name
+        required: true
+        default: UniXNU/UniXNU-sheng
+      device_ref:
+        description: Device repository ref
+        required: true
+        default: main
+      defconfig:
+        description: Defconfig name
+        required: true
+        default: sheng_defconfig
+      steps:
+        description: Steps to run
+        type: choice
+        options:
+          - kernel
+          - kernel userdata
+          - kernel userdata payload
+        default: kernel userdata
+      ipsw_url:
+        description: IPSW URL (empty uses board.toml)
+        required: false
+        default: ""
+      pre_build:
+        description: Optional shell commands run in the UniXNU checkout before the kernel build
+        required: false
+        default: ""
+      trust_cache_url:
+        description: Trust cache bundle URL (optional)
+        required: false
+        default: ""
+      owner_trust_cache:
+        description: Treat the trust cache URL as an owner-signed bundle
+        type: boolean
+        default: false
+      data_seed_url:
+        description: Data seed URL (optional)
+        required: false
+        default: ""
+      grow_gib:
+        description: Grow the Data seed to this many GiB (optional)
+        required: false
+        default: ""
+      skip_setup:
+        description: Mark Setup as done in the Data seed
+        type: boolean
+        default: false
+      upload_userdata:
+        description: Upload the userdata image (large)
+        type: boolean
+        default: false
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+concurrency:
+  group: macos-build-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+env:
+  HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE: 1
+  HOMEBREW_NO_INSTALL_CLEANUP: 1
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    runs-on: macos-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 360
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          repository: ${{ inputs.device_repository }}
+          ref: ${{ inputs.device_ref }}
+          path: device
+          token: ${{ secrets.UNIXNU_DEVICE_TOKEN || github.token }}
+
+      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: "3.12"
+
+      - name: Report the runner toolchain
+        run: |
+          sw_vers
+          uname -m
+          xcodebuild -version
+          xcode-select -p
+          xcrun --sdk iphoneos --find mig || echo 'mig not found for iphoneos'
+
+      - name: Install host tools
+        run: |
+          brew install cmake ninja unifdef llvm mtools dtc
+          echo "$(brew --prefix llvm)/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+          echo "$(brew --prefix unifdef)/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
+
+      - name: Verify the host tools
+        run: |
+          for tool in git make clang cmake ninja unifdef mtools dtc xcodebuild; do
+            printf '%-10s %s\n' "$tool" "$(command -v "$tool" || echo MISSING)"
+          done
+
+      - name: Select the device
+        run: |
+          ./unixnu defconfig "${{ inputs.defconfig }}" -D "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/device"
+          ./unixnu fetch xnu libplatform libdispatch AvailabilityVersions libpthread \
+                          corecrypto-2023 IOStorageFamily -D "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/device"
+
+      - name: Prepare inputs
+        env:
+          TRUST_CACHE_URL: ${{ inputs.trust_cache_url }}
+          DATA_SEED_URL: ${{ inputs.data_seed_url }}
+          GROW_GIB: ${{ inputs.grow_gib }}
+          SKIP_SETUP: ${{ inputs.skip_setup }}
+        run: |
+          if [ -n "$TRUST_CACHE_URL" ]; then
+            curl -fL "$TRUST_CACHE_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/trustcache"
+          fi
+          if [ -n "$DATA_SEED_URL" ]; then
+            curl -fL "$DATA_SEED_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/data.dbr"
+            if [ -n "$GROW_GIB" ]; then
+              python3 scripts/seed-data-grow.py --gib "$GROW_GIB" "$RUNNER_TEMP/data.dbr" "$RUNNER_TEMP/data-grow.dbr"
+              mv "$RUNNER_TEMP/data-grow.dbr" "$RUNNER_TEMP/data.dbr"
+            fi
+          elif [ -n "$GROW_GIB" ]; then
+            echo "grow_gib needs data_seed_url" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          if [ "$SKIP_SETUP" = "true" ] && [ ! -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/data.dbr" ]; then
+            echo "skip_setup needs data_seed_url" >&2
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      - name: Run pre-build steps
+        if: inputs.pre_build != ''
+        env:
+          PRE_BUILD: ${{ inputs.pre_build }}
+          DEVICE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/device
+        run: bash -euo pipefail -c "$PRE_BUILD"
+
+      - name: Build kernel
+        env:
+          IPSW_URL: ${{ inputs.ipsw_url }}
+        run: |
+          args=()
+          if [ -n "$IPSW_URL" ]; then args+=(--ipsw "$IPSW_URL"); fi
+          ./unixnu build kernel "${args[@]}"
+
+      - name: Build userdata
+        if: contains(inputs.steps, 'userdata')
+        env:
+          IPSW_URL: ${{ inputs.ipsw_url }}
+        run: |
+          args=()
+          if [ -n "$IPSW_URL" ]; then args+=(--ipsw "$IPSW_URL"); fi
+          ./unixnu build userdata "${args[@]}"
+
+      - name: Build payload
+        if: contains(inputs.steps, 'payload')
+        env:
+          UNIQUE_CHIP_ID: ${{ secrets.UNIXNU_UNIQUE_CHIP_ID }}
+          SKIP_SETUP: ${{ inputs.skip_setup }}
+          OWNER_TRUST_CACHE: ${{ inputs.owner_trust_cache }}
+        run: |
+          args=()
+          if [ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/trustcache" ]; then
+            if [ "$OWNER_TRUST_CACHE" = "true" ]; then
+              args+=(--owner-trust-cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/trustcache")
+            else
+              args+=(--trust-cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/trustcache")
+            fi
+          fi
+          if [ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/data.dbr" ]; then args+=(--data-ramdisk "$RUNNER_TEMP/data.dbr"); fi
+          if [ -n "$UNIQUE_CHIP_ID" ]; then args+=(--unique-chip-id "$UNIQUE_CHIP_ID"); fi
+          if [ "$SKIP_SETUP" = "true" ]; then args+=(--skip-setup); fi
+          ./unixnu build payload "${args[@]}"
+
+      - name: Upload kernel and payload
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: unixnu-${{ inputs.defconfig }}
+          path: |
+            out/*/kernel/**
+            out/*/payload/**
+            out/*/logs/**
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 7
+
+      - name: Upload userdata
+        if: inputs.upload_userdata && contains(inputs.steps, 'userdata')
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: unixnu-userdata-${{ inputs.defconfig }}
+          path: out/*/userdata/**
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 7
+
+      - name: Remove proprietary inputs
+        if: always()
+        run: |
+          rm -rf out/ipsw out/feeds device/.cache/firmware out/*/tree/.cache/firmware
+          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/trustcache" "$RUNNER_TEMP/data.dbr" "$RUNNER_TEMP/data-grow.dbr"
